Annual leave carry-over Policy
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on annual leave carry-over at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
A maximum of 5 unused vacation days can be carried over and must be taken before 31 March.
Conditions
Statutory leave days are handled separately under local law.
Validity
Version 3.0, effective 2025-01-01. Supersedes version 1.2 (2022). Approved by the Management Committee.
